definitions.explanation: A concept from tea ceremony emphasizing that each meeting is unique and should be treasured. Every encounter is a singular, irreplaceable experience.

examples.japanese: {一期一会|いちごいちえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to treasure every encounter.
Encounters during travel are once-in-a-lifetime experiences.

examples.japanese: {一期一会|いちごいちえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もてなす→もてなす：10635_motenasu⟧。
examples.english: We serve customers with the spirit of treasuring each encounter.

notes:
{一期一会|いちごいちえ} is a four-character idiom (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) meaning "once in a lifetime encounter."

ETYMOLOGY:
From Japanese tea ceremony (⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧), attributed to the tea master ⟦{千利休|せんのりきゅう}→千利休：noentry⟧. Literally means "one lifetime, one meeting."

CORE MEANING:
Every encounter is unique and will never happen again exactly the same way. Emphasizes treating each meeting with full attention and appreciation.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {一期一会|いちごいちえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧: the spirit of treasuring each encounter
- {一期一会|いちごいちえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to value each encounter

USAGE:
Commonly used in hospitality, customer service, and when reflecting on meaningful encounters. Also appears as a life philosophy emphasizing mindfulness and living in the present.
